title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1984-04-27
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24 bit) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 07/2013
source: AUD: 3x Nakamichi CM300 w/CP4 shotguns > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLIIS, floor just to left (stage right) of soundboard, taped by Tim Friend & Joe Morrone.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording capturing a tight, fluid rendition of 'Playing in the Band'.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised as very nice, delivering clear sound and lively crowd ambience. Musically the show shines with a tightly executed, flowing version of "Playing in the Band" that keeps listeners smiling from start to finish.

ai_rating.rationale: Both the performance (tight, fluid PITB) and the audience recording are highly praised; limited review count lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very nice audience tape with clear instrument separation and good crowd ambience; no major flaws noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Opening with a concise yet fully expressed 'Playing in the Band' sets an upbeat, smile‑inducing tone for the concert.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Continues his preferred segue of China Doll or Crazy Fingers after PITB.
